title: Existing normalized ordinary tensor comparison with independent site universes
statement: Let C and D be sites with object universe s and morphism universe h. Work with rings, modules and underlying sets in max(s,h). Let uInv be left adjoint to uPush and preserve finite limits, R and RI be commutative ring sheaves, I an algebraic inverse-image presentation of uInv [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], S a commutative ring sheaf on D, and c:RI→S. Let T be a specified module functor, equipped with object equations T(M)=changeOfRings(c,I.modules(M)) and the corresponding equations on morphisms. Then there exists a unique CanonicalRingedTensorComparison: maps q_M inserting 1 tensor m in sheafified scalar extension and natural isomorphisms T(M tensor_R N)≅T(M) tensor_S T(N), with the generalized pure-tensor formula of [def-weil-pbc-canonical-ringed-tensor-comparison], retaining the independent site universes.

proof.text: Use the existing independently sized normalizedTensorator_exists construction, with its specified scalarInsertion. Assemble the common five-field comparison record; insertion is definitionally the prescribed sheafification of 1 tensor m. proof.text: The insertion normalization determines q sectionwise. For the tensorator, use the universal generalized pair of sections and preservation of binary products to apply the pure-tensor formula to every pair of inverse-image sections. Applying inverse tensorators identifies their values on inserted pure tensors. Scalar-extension and sheafification universal properties show those tensors generate. Thus mu agrees, and proof irrelevance identifies the remaining fields.

proof.text: For the accompanying unit normalization, construct the inverse-image rank-one module isomorphism from the given ring and module underlying isomorphisms and their action compatibility. Construct the scalar-extension unit isomorphism by sectionwise scalar multiplication followed by module sheafification. Transport along hobj and hmap using the specified natural scalar-extension presentation. The pure formula with the second module the coefficient ring proves the right-unitor equation on scalar-extension generators; sheafification extends it to all sections. The equation at the coefficient module determines the unit isomorphism uniquely by tensor-unit cancellation. These proofs are private helpers with independent site and coefficient universes, specialized in the public theorems.

theorem canonicalRingedTensorComparison_existsUnique
    (uPush : Sheaf JD (Type (max s h)) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type (max s h)))
    (adj : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (hmap : ∀ {M N : SheafOfModules.{max s h} ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max s h}
      RingCat.{max s h})).obj
      R)} (f : M ⟶ N), L.map f =
      eqToHom (hobj M) ≫ changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map f) ≫
        eqToHom (hobj N).symm) :
    Nonempty (CanonicalRingedTensorComparison R S RI uInv I c L hobj) ∧
      Subsingleton (CanonicalRingedTensorComparison R S RI uInv I c L hobj)
